name: dsh-akn-plugin
description: Installable DeepSeek Harness plugin and reference implementation for the Agent Experience Network and AEXP 0.1

scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @aen/protocol typecheck && pnpm --filter @aen/protocol build && pnpm --filter @aen/adapter-sample typecheck && pnpm --filter @aen/adapter-sample build && pnpm --filter @aen/adapter-dsh typecheck && pnpm --filter @aen/adapter-dsh build && pnpm --filter @aen/local-store typecheck && pnpm --filter @aen/local-store build && pnpm --filter @aen/workbench typecheck && pnpm --filter @aen/workbench build && pnpm --filter @aen/evaluation typecheck && pnpm --filter @aen/evaluation build && pnpm --filter @aen/promotion typecheck && pnpm --filter @aen/promotion build && pnpm --filter @aen/hub typecheck && pnpm --filter @aen/hub build && pnpm --filter @aen/client typecheck && pnpm --filter @aen/client build && pnpm --filter @aen/dsh-plugin typecheck && pnpm --filter @aen/dsh-plugin build && pnpm --filter @aen/cli typecheck && pnpm --filter @aen/hub-app typecheck && pnpm --filter @aen/mcp-server typecheck
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm typecheck && pnpm --filter @aen/hub-app build && node scripts/multi-process-e2e.mjs
scripts.test:dsh-evaluation-driver: pnpm typecheck && pnpm --filter @aen/cli build && node scripts/dsh-evaluation-driver-smoke.mjs
scripts.test:hub-deployment: pnpm typecheck && pnpm --filter @aen/hub-app build && node scripts/hub-deployment-smoke.mjs
scripts.test:postgres: pnpm --filter @aen/protocol build && pnpm --filter @aen/promotion build && pnpm --filter @aen/hub build && node scripts/real-postgres-test.mjs
scripts.bench:performance: pnpm typecheck && pnpm --filter @aen/hub-app build && node scripts/performance-smoke.mjs
scripts.bench:dsh-hot-path: pnpm --filter @aen/protocol build && pnpm --filter @aen/adapter-dsh build && pnpm --filter @aen/local-store build && pnpm --filter @aen/client build && pnpm --filter @aen/workbench build && pnpm --filter @aen/dsh-plugin build && pnpm --filter @aen/dsh-plugin benchmark:hot-path
scripts.conformance: pnpm --filter @aen/protocol build && pnpm --filter @aen/cli start conformance run --root ../..
scripts.audit:release: pnpm audit:source && pnpm audit:links && pnpm audit:licenses && pnpm audit --prod
